system.description:
Motivating a team of oxen or horses is an arduous task that requires skill and a certain delicacy. The Driving skill is used for maneuvering carts and carriages over roads.

Obstacles: Use this skill in place of Riding when determining pursuit or the celerity of travel. It would also be used in the rare case of field maneuvers involving carts and chariots.

Skill Type: Peasant. Tools: No.

Root: Will/Agility

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 268
